lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a series of semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gills, exhibiting a grid-like alignment with the dorsal-ventral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical ridges of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal carinae are visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance peaks to low-luminance troughs beneath.

other_distinctive_markers: Several commensal organisms (remoras) are visible in the ventral region, trailing the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
